root_idea.summary: An endpoint, goal, or limiting extent; the root is oriented toward what a span reaches as its limit.
root_idea.development: From the idea of a terminal extent, أَمَد denotes a span considered with regard to its endpoint, especially a period or term, and can also denote an intervening distance or extent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The canonical Quranic noun is displayed under the normalized citation form أَمَد.

senses.definition: A term or span of time considered with regard to its endpoint; a period whose limit may be unspecified or specified in relation to something.
senses.usage_conditions: Temporal use, emphasizing the eventual limit or goal of the span rather than time viewed generally; it may be distant or otherwise defined by context.

senses.definition: An intervening extent or distance between two points, understood as a reach toward a limit.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a spatial interval, especially in a construction describing the distance between one thing and another.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb used with عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To declare or specify a time, term, utmost extent, or limit by reference to its endpoint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II verb; a causative or specifying use of the term/limit concept.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A life-term, specifically either of the two terminal points of a person's life: birth or death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical Arabic use referring to one of the two defining times of a life.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The starting point or goal of horses in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use for either endpoint of a racecourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a term or limit; limited in duration.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Adjectival construction, including agreement with a feminine noun in ذَاتُ أَمَدٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder, or what remains, of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct nominal derivative referring to what is left over.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a skin or water-container, exhausted so that not a gulp remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use for a completely drained skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An extreme term, limit, or point that has been reached or attained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported lexical expression is retained with its supplied headword and gloss.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The verb's anger meaning is represented as a Classical Arabic branch.
The Form II specifying-a-term construction is represented.
The unit supplies the temporal-term and extent/distance branches.
A period of life reached is covered by the temporal-term sense.
The specialized birth-or-death life endpoints use is represented separately.
The specialized race-endpoint use is represented separately.
An unbounded or unknown-limit span of time is covered by the temporal-term sense.
A particular time is covered by the temporal-term sense.
The adjectival limited-duration construction is represented.
The derivative meaning remainder is represented.
The specialized exhausted-skin description is represented.
The reported attained-limit expression is retained as a Classical branch.

cautions: أَمَد differs from أَبَد in that it denotes a span considered with regard to an endpoint; أَبَد denotes an unlimited duration.
The Quranic occurrence in 3:30 is represented as an intervening distance, while the other supplied occurrences illustrate the temporal-term use.
The Lane unit headed أَمَرَهُ has an unusual headword-to-gloss pairing; its supplied lexical interpretation is retained without normalization.
